- S02E06 "The Fight": (No detailed context provided, but an episode in the season.)

- S02E13 "The Secret": Jim is forced to spend time with Michael to prevent Michael from revealing Jim's feelings for Pam. Meanwhile, Dwight investigates whether Oscar is truly sick when Oscar takes a "sick day."

Overall, season 2 focuses on office dynamics, Michael's antics, and the developing relationships among the staff, especially Jim and Pam.

Creed is a quirky and somewhat mysterious character at Dunder Mifflin. He is portrayed as an older employee who often makes cryptic or humorous remarks. For example, he says, "I'm thirty. Well, in November I'll be thirty," which is likely a joke about his age (SCENE 029). He also refers to himself as one of the "old timers" along with Michael, indicating he has been at the company a long time (SCENE 014).

Creed seems to have a laid-back and somewhat eccentric personality. He once tried to start his own paper company and attempted to poach clients, showing a bit of a schemer side (SCENE 056). He also has a humorous and casual way of speaking, such as when he says, "Everything's cool, dude" (SCENE 028).

He is involved in various office antics and has a somewhat mysterious background, as seen when he talks about pirate code but only understands it without speaking it (SCENE 021). Creed also has a playful side, as he mentions still having his medal from the Office Olympics (SCENE 106).

Overall, Creed is a quirky, somewhat enigmatic character who adds humor and oddball charm to the office environment.
